title: One-Time Commercial Payment Destination Configuration
exact_irreducible_action: Provide 1 preferred payment rail (e.g. Stripe Payment Link URL, PayPal.me link, or Business IBAN) in events/runtime-state/payment_destination_config.json
post_auth_automated_sequence: 1. System detects valid payment destination in payment_destination_config.json
2. Advances canonical payment state to PAYMENT_READY_HUMAN_RECEIPT_VERIFICATION
3. All future generated invoices automatically embed the live payment rail
4. Client responses auto-issue actionable invoices with zero human editing
human_involvement_per_economic_cycle: APPROACHES_ZERO (One-time payment link setup unlocks all future transactions)
